title: Savory German Chicken Gratin
description: A hearty German-inspired dish featuring chicken and a creamy gratin. Perfect for a cold evening.
instructions: Season the chicken breast with salt and black pepper.
Sear the chicken in a skillet until browned on both sides. Set aside.
In the same skillet, sauté the sliced onion until softened.
Transfer the onion to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Place the seared chicken on top of the onion.
Pour the luscious cream and sprinkle with grated cheddar cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 25-30 minutes or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Garnish with chopped fresh parsley. Serve hot.
